notes_for_editor: Site identity rests on coordinates alone. The list gives 33.86970, -84.46803 for vining; Wikipedia gives 33.8696172, -84.4682877 for Mount Wilkinson (also Vinings Mountain). No source names the mountain as this lookout's site. The list's 1175 has no unit stated; the record converts it as feet (358.1 m), and Wikipedia's mountain figure is 1,165 ft, so the two differ by about ten feet. Searches of Vinings and Cobb sources and the NHLR Georgia list (no Vining entry) found no build date, staffing, or fate history. The Forest Fire Lookout Association Georgia list was not readable. Brief record county and elevation are consistent with the list; no corrections. Access and public reachability of the summit are not established by any source read.
